description: Trigger and behavior evals for the ovphysx USD authoring skill. Positive cases author physics into USD; negative cases are runtime/tensor/rendering tasks the skill must not claim.

cases.prompt: Write a .usda scene for ovphysx with a box that falls onto a ground plane.
expected_behavior: Authors a PhysicsScene prim with gravity direction and magnitude
Adds a static ground collider (PhysicsCollisionAPI, no PhysicsRigidBodyAPI)
Adds a dynamic body: PhysicsRigidBodyAPI on an Xform with a child geometry carrying PhysicsCollisionAPI
Places the body above the ground so it can fall

cases.prompt: Using Python and usd-core, create a USD file with a dynamic rigid body and mass that ovphysx can load.
expected_behavior: Uses UsdPhysics typed schemas (Scene, RigidBodyAPI, CollisionAPI, MassAPI)
Creates the stage, sets up axis and metersPerUnit, and a default prim
Applies RigidBodyAPI + MassAPI to the body and CollisionAPI to its geometry
Saves the stage to a file

cases.prompt: My box in a USD scene passes through the floor in ovphysx. How do I make it collide?
expected_behavior: Identifies that the body and/or ground geometry is missing PhysicsCollisionAPI
Shows applying PhysicsCollisionAPI to the geometry

cases.prompt: How do I enable CCD on a rigid body when authoring a USD scene for ovphysx in Python?
expected_behavior: Explains PhysX schemas are codeless in ovphysx (no typed Python class)
Registers them via Plug.Registry().RegisterPlugins([str(p) for p in ovphysx.codeless_schema_paths()])
Applies the schema generically with prim.ApplyAPI("PhysxRigidBodyAPI")

cases.prompt: Write a loop that steps an ovphysx simulation and reads rigid-body poses with the tensor API.
expected_behavior: Does not activate ovphysx-usd-authoring (this is runtime stepping / tensor I/O, not USD authoring)

cases.prompt: Clone one ovphysx environment into 1000 parallel copies for reinforcement learning.
expected_behavior: Does not activate ovphysx-usd-authoring (this is the runtime clone API)

cases.prompt: Improve the render materials and viewport frame rate for my Omniverse scene.
expected_behavior: Does not activate ovphysx-usd-authoring (rendering/performance is out of scope)
